name: Bamboo shoots
description: Pale crisp shoots, sliced into stir-fries and hotpot.

tcm.note: Zhu sun is cold — it clears heat and resolves phlegm, and is held back from cold constitutions.

ayurveda.note: Not classical outside the northeast; read as shita.

histamine.note: Fresh and canned are low; the pickled and fermented kinds are a different matter entirely.
